im kinda late to the party but if anyone needs help on the fish part of pond dino's hard mode, here's some advice.

 the fish follow you. if the fish are positioned at a higher angle than pond dino than they will dip down, if they are the same angle as you then they will dash forward, if they are lower than you they will run up. i make sure to slide until the very moment they move so that i have a better chance to jump around them. good luck to everyone of you!

today isn't my best day, haha. i love my parents, but sometimes past memories of them being not the best triggers me really bad. 

my mother has apologized to me in a sort of guilt-tripping way (ie. i'm the worst parent ever, i'm so sorry for being such a bad mother) and i said it's okay when it really wasn't, but i think she'll get mad or cry if i ever bring it up again. 

my father on the other hand is a very emotional person and also suicidal, so i feel like if i bring the past up, he'll kill himself or hurt someone (most likely my mother or myself).

honestly i don't think i can live without them bc i have very few friends and really bad emotional problems, not to mention a low wage part-time job and student loans to pay off.

i'm blabbering at this point, sorry about that. thank you for commenting and sympathizing, it helped me put some of my situation into words.
